errors.what: Crank angular speed is wrong. The spec requires 90 deg/s (one revolution per 4 s), so the crank should read 30 deg at t=0.33 s, 90 deg at t=1.00 s and 270 deg at t=3.00 s. The panel and the drawn crank instead advance only 9 deg per 0.33 s (27 deg/s, about 0.3x the required speed). Across the 12 frames, which should cover a full revolution, the crank only reaches 99 deg. Link geometry, assembly branch, direction of rotation and the rocker values for the crank angles shown are consistent with the spec.
